question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
TB Solution: 

The correct answer is **around**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• '**around'** means **in a position or direction surrounding, or in a direction going along the edge of or from one part to another.** (इधर-उधर)

 -Example: Turn **around** and go back the way you came.

 
• "**around**" is an **adverb and a preposition.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• "**everywhere**" means in or to every place.
 
• "**across**" means from one side of something to the other.
 
• "**over**" means straight above something, but not touching it.

Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is '**around**'
